WITH fee_order_join AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    o.timespan
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL THEN rebrate / feerate END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as match_count
  FROM fee_order_join
  GROUP BY timespan
),
avg_match_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) as cross_group_avg FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.avg_ratio,
    gs.match_count,
    amc.cross_group_avg
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN avg_match_count amc
  WHERE gs.match_count > amc.cross_group_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(match_count) as total_matches,
  AVG(match_count - cross_group_avg) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_groups;
